literature_notes: All three ledger lines (L1, L2, L3) describe a single construct: AAV-pGFAP-EphB1-HA, in which an HA tag is fused to the C-terminus (after residue 984) of full-length mouse EphB1. The topology landmarks place residues 563–984 in the intracellular domain; residue 984 (A) is the last intracellular residue. A C-terminal tag therefore faces the cytoplasm, not the extracellular surface, and does not qualify as an extracellular surface tag site. No ledger line reports any insertion at the extracellular N-terminus (residue 18, after signal-peptide cleavage at 1–17), in any extracellular loop, or anywhere else in the extracellular domain (18–540). Because the ledger contains no evidence of a tolerated extracellular insertion for EPHB1, zero sites are reported.

literature_other_positions.note: HA tag fused to the C-terminus of full-length EphB1 (after residue 984, A); residue 984 lies in the intracellular domain (563–984), so this tag faces the cytoplasm, not the extracellular surface.
